text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, preparations for the stage event 
are in the final stretch. I'd better 
double-check the supplies...!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ? It's awfully noisy...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!! The entryway is covered in 
blood--!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"This is—just as I thought. Please calm 
down, it's red paint, not blood!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"That is correct! And rest assured, 
everyone! This officer is already 
investigating the matter!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: And! We already have a person of interest!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
We have eyewitness reports on Sky-san, 
Cafe-san, and Ramonu-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
There is a high probability that the 
culprit is among them.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —No. I don't think that's the case.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! How can you say that with such 
certainty?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—Very well. Based on my analysis, I shall 
lay everything bare.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Bear witness to the brilliant skills of... 
"Great Detective Royce-chan"!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
First, regarding the information submitted 
about Sky-san: "She was seen smiling 
suspiciously by the lobby window"... it 
says!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I see. However, she is—an unparalleled cat 
lover!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
According to the information I gathered, 
she is mindful enough of cats to check 
detergent ingredients. Would someone like 
that really scatter paint around?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Even though a neighborhood cat has been 
visiting the lobby window for the past 
month.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
In other words! She was simply standing by 
the window, smiling in anticipation of her 
secret rendezvous with that cat!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I-I see! ...Then what about you, Cafe-san? 
We received a tip claiming that "there was 
a red stain on her clothes"...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my. If I remember correctly, weren't 
you caught up in one of Tachyon-san's 
experiments this afternoon, Cafe-san?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And the color of the chemical Tachyon-san 
was using at the time was—a brilliant 
red!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
In that case, there's a strong chance 
Cafe's red stain is completely unrelated 
to this incident!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... In that case, the remaining 
eyewitness report is Ramonu-senpai holding 
art supplies at the scene... Meaning, she 
was the one who...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No. What was spilled on the floor was 
water-based paint. Ramonu-san paints with 
oils.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"And Ramonu-san's hundreds of abstract 
paintings have very distinct color usage. 
According to my data after viewing them 
all..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fewer than five of the pieces use only a 
single color. Most of them utilize 
multiple colors.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
In other words! It is unthinkable that Ms. 
Ramonu would carry around enough red dye 
to stain the entire floor!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
After questioning them, it turned out they 
had alibis, proving all three innocent. 
It's just as Royce-san said...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this puts the investigation back 
at square one! Grrr...! Curse you, real 
culprit~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No, we're not back at square one. With 
this, the true culprit will be brought to 
light.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Making a mess of the lobby and throwing 
many dorm residents into chaos. The true 
culprit was—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: It's me!! I'm so sorry!!!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: What did you saaaay?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Well, the paint has arrived, so 
preparations for the stage event are going 
smoothly. Let's hurry up and carry it 
over!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD――SPLAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Aaaaaah~~!! T-The paint bucket 
is...!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... In that case, you could have 
just stepped forward sooner...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...As for that.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I just came up with a new persona—Great 
Detective Royce-chan—so I couldn't help 
myself!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Please reflect on your actions!!!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry! I will make sure to 
clean it thoroughly!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, I'm doing some serious 
soul-searching. Prepping large-scale 
projects in the dorm is strictly a no-go, 
huh...?”
choice_data_list: Failure is the mother of success!
Meticulous as you are, spilling paint...?
Meticulous as you are, spilling paint...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, I'm doing some serious 
soul-searching. Prepping large-scale 
projects in the dorm is strictly a no-go, 
huh...?”
choice_data_list: Failure is the mother of success!
Meticulous as you are, spilling paint...?
Meticulous as you are, spilling paint...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
True. This whole commotion helped me 
reaffirm my analytical skills, and—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
――Aha!! How about making a Detective 
Royce-chan video series!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Delivering intellectually stimulating 
entertainment...! I have a feeling this is 
gonna go massively viral!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah... There's just no hiding anything from 
you, is there?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, a cat came dashing in from 
outside— and knocked the bucket over with 
its tail. Fortunately, none of the paint 
got on the cat, but..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Failing to anticipate such a situation was 
entirely my fault. It was a good learning 
experience, though!
